digest.component_or_area: git repository history stripping and reclamation
propositions: The history-strip script must use only stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) without new dependencies to rewrite the tickets branch, removing .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ directories while preserving commit count, merge topology, and tree byte-identity.
The script must refuse to operate on blob:none partial clones and require a fresh unfiltered clone to avoid fast-import blob-not-found failures.

The re-add set for .bridge_state/ files must be derived dynamically via git ls-tree rather than hardcoded, and commit messages must be parsed by byte length to handle messages beginning with M or D without corruption.
The rewritten branch must produce a pack size under 150 MB, prove no commits touch .bridge_state.bak-retarget/, and produce a tree byte-identical to the old tip after dynamic re-add.
The dry-run script must perform all graph, tree, history-removal, and pack-size assertions before returning success and must never push to the remote, leaving the source ref unchanged.
